content.text:
I'd take option 1, "החברה בראש השורה". I'm fairly sure, not certain. What decided it: I only care about the S&P, and option 1 opens straight on the "עוקב מדד s&p 500" group. Every company is in one list there with its fee and its return: מנורה at the top with "0.52%", הראל, מגדל, כלל, all names I know. I didn't have to work anything out.

**Where I looked, in order:**
- **Top of the page:** the heading "כל המסלולים בכל החברות", then the three option buttons. I noticed "מומלץ" on option 3.
- **Option 1:** I read the S&P group. Fees run "0.52%" to "0.71%", and the 3-year returns are about 13%, so they all look pretty much the same. That's why the fee is what I'd go by. אילון with "עוד לא דווח" and "חדש" I'd skip, never heard of them. מור is the most expensive at "0.71%".
- **Option 2:** it's grouped by company. It opens with הראל and then a long list of tracks I don't care about: אג"ח, כספי, הלכה. I scrolled fast and only caught the heading "מור". To compare companies on the S&P I'd have to go through each company one by one. Annoying.
- **Option 3 (the recommended one):** it's a big grid, "כל החברות מול כל סוגי ההשקעה". Next to the names I saw the S&P column and could pick out מנורה "0.52%". But it's 12 columns of percentages in brown and orange, and that's a wall. From the first line I took it that stronger orange means a higher fee, but I'm not sure I read that right. Under the grid there's the same S&P list as option 1, so it's really option 1 with a grid on top that I had to scroll past.

**What I skimmed or skipped:** the explanation paragraphs above each option, the grey notes under the tables, the "בשרטוט בלבד" lines, the "מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה" link, and the "קופה" number column.

**Words I didn't get:**
- "מט"ח" next to the little donuts. I don't know what that percentage is, or what the yellow and turquoise colours mean.
- "חשיפה".
- "דמי ניהול מההפקדות" with 0%.
- "פחות מ־3 שנים".
- In option 3, "2 מסלולים" inside a cell, and "—" next to "חדש".

**What bothered me:**
- Option 2 just drags on.
- In option 3, too many identical numbers and colours.
- The page itself never says anything in shekels, only percentages and "מיליארד". I still don't really feel the difference between 0.52% and 0.71%.
